               THEN ca.Claim_Amount

    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_coverage" AS cc
    JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."claim" AS c
      ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" AS ca
